title: Dock a hand shower in its wall holder: steer the hanging hose into the cup's front slot and seat the handle
instruction: Put the hand shower back in its wall holder: hose in through the cup's front slot, handle down into the cup, let go.
context: Everyone who rinses with a hand shower docks it in its holder after. The cup closes round the handle, so the hose must go in sideways through the front slot before the handle can seat. Unlike the board's cable tasks (cable hung on hooks, plugs in open channels), the part goes down into a closed cup while it hangs on an anchored hose.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases: x forward, y left; heights above the table. Full size. Wall panel: blue-grey tiled board, 44 wide x 36 tall x 1.2 thick, standing on the table, face at x 47, y -22 to +22. Holder: black ABS cup on the wall, conical bore 26 mm at the bottom ring and 34 mm at the rim, 32 mm deep, 4 mm wall, front slot 18 mm wide at the ring (24 mm at the rim) facing the robot, leaning 15 degrees toward the robot; ring centre at x 39.5, y +2.5, height 15.1; arm 62 x 24 x 16 mm to a 50 mm wall rosette. Outlet elbow: black 20 mm bar on the wall, spout pointing down at x 45.8, y +16.5, height 17.3. Hose: black, 12 mm, 0.50 m, 85 g, fixed at the spout; laid down the wall, along its foot to y -4.5, then up to the handset. Hand shower: white ABS, 250 mm, 100 g: chrome nut 20 mm diameter x 10 mm; round handle tapering 22 to 28 mm over 10 to 31 mm from the nut's tip, 28 mm to 160 mm; red band 9 to 15 mm from the tip; round head 90 mm diameter x 28 mm thick centred 205 mm from the tip. It lies face down along x at y -4.5, nut tip at x 39, height 11.4, head toward the robot, handle overhanging the ledge by 10.2 cm. Ledge: grey stone block 15.8 x 9 x 10 tall, fixed, x 13 to 28.8, y -9 to 0.
scoring: From the handset's pose against the fixed cup (ruler, side photo, video). Seat point S: on the handle axis 24 mm from the nut's tip. Seated: S within -4 to +6 mm of the bottom ring's centre along the cup axis and 4 mm off it, handle axis within 10 degrees of the cup's (real check: top of the red band 3 to 13 mm below the cup). Released: every finger pad 3 cm or more from the handset and the last 15 cm of hose. Still: nut tip under 1 cm/s and 5 deg/s for 2 s. 1.0: seated, released, still. 0.4: released and still, not seated, nut end inside the bore 10 mm or more below the rim or through the bottom ring. 0 otherwise: still held (even if seated), hung on a pinched hose, beside the cup, or left on the ledge. 0 for the run if the handset is ever dropped (falling over 0.6 m/s, or any part under 3 cm above the table, no finger within 3 cm) or the hose is torn off.
reset_notes: Lay the handset face down on the ledge at its tape marks, hose down the wall, along its foot and up to the nut. Nothing is consumed; no water. Real build (printed holder and handset, McMaster-Carr 5034K23 hose): README.
fidelity: Approximate. Handset, cup, slot and 12 mm hose are full size (real build: printed holder and handset from fabricate.py, 12.7 mm neoprene hose ballasted to 0.17 kg/m; README). The hose is 0.5 m (real 1.5 to 2 m), a chain of 20 rigid 25 mm segments with bend springs, no twist. Cup and handle rigid; no water, no swivel at the nut. Holder 15 cm above the table, not head height. A handset still held at the end scores 0.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (right arm reached the handset and dragged it along the ledge, never docked it); demo: 1.0 (right arm lifted the handset, seated it in the wall cup, released and withdrew)
